author: claude-opus-5
note: Authored BEFORE reading GLM/Kimi returns, so the fusion has three independent sources rather than two plus an echo.

directions.hero_mechanics: Swans.mp4 near-full-bleed and almost motionless; one line of type low-left; world layers drift so slowly the movement is felt rather than seen
directions.phenomenon: the water's light does not stop at the video edge - reflections fall across the page surface and move on the type itself
anti_specs: no stat bar, badge row or logo wall above the fold
nothing animates on load - motion begins only when the visitor scrolls
directions.tradeoff: lowest immediate wow; a trainer skimming in five seconds may not learn what the product IS before leaving

directions.hero_mechanics: scroll position drives the Swans.mp4 playhead; the page travels inward and downward - sky to water to plaza to one person - and never returns to the sky
directions.phenomenon: the sun rises as you scroll - the page is literally getting lighter as the visitor learns more, and by THE FORK it is morning
anti_specs: no parallel columns anywhere - the page is one continuous descent
no cards or tiles above the fold
never cuts back to the opening wide shot
directions.tradeoff: heaviest to build and the biggest mobile performance risk; the manifesto lands late, so a visitor who bounces early gets atmosphere and no argument

directions.hero_mechanics: the world seen from above - a lit plaza at night with figures moving through it; the swans pass THROUGH the frame rather than owning it
directions.phenomenon: every lit window is somebody training - windows warm and pulse as activity happens, so the building is a live activity feed you read as light
anti_specs: no faces above the fold - people stay small until the visitor travels inward
no empty hero - the world is populated from the first frame
directions.tradeoff: the closest of the four to reading as a city-builder game rather than a professional training platform, and it demotes the swans from hero to passer-by

directions.hero_mechanics: swans dimmed and held behind; a real progress chart draws itself in the foreground as the page settles, line by line
directions.phenomenon: the chart's line is made of the same light as the water - data and world are one substance, so the product appears to be part of the place rather than pasted onto it
anti_specs: no screenshot chrome, browser frames or device mockups
no 'dashboard preview' framing or floating UI cards
the chart is never a static image - it must draw
directions.tradeoff: most likely of the four to convert a skeptical trainer and least likely to make anyone feel anything; risks becoming a SaaS page wearing a swan
